formula: ema(safe_div(numerator=close - (high + low) / 2, denominator=high - low) * volume * (1 + safe_div(numerator=volume, denominator=ts_mean(volume, 10)) - 1), 5)
rationale: Preserves the core imbalance-volume interaction from the parent. Shortens the volume baseline from 20 to 10 days and replaces the 5-day SMA with an exponential moving average (span=5) to improve responsiveness and potentially boost IC while maintaining RankIC stability.
filter: volume > 0 AND not is_suspend AND close < high_limit AND close > low_limit
